jobs.description:
As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

Join a company in Roeselare focusing on utility vehicles. You take care of preparing trailers for inspection, perform maintenance, and replace parts like brakes and shock absorbers. You also carry out welding tasks. Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a must. You work independently, communicate in different languages, and handle a variety of tasks every day. Ready for a new step? Apply now!

• At least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• Able to work independently

• Practical and problem-solving attitude

• Can communicate in Dutch, French, English, or German

• Welding skills preferred

• Basic hydraulics or electricity knowledge is an advantage

As a weaver, you’ll be hands-on with Dornier dobby and jacquard weaving machines. You’ll keep the looms supplied with bobbins and yarns, ensure everything runs efficiently, and carry out small repairs when needed.
Your day involves moving between machines, fixing thread breaks, and keeping your work area in top condition. You collaborate with colleagues to deliver a high-quality, exclusive textile product.
Ready to put your weaving skills to work and be part of a motivated team? Apply today!

• Experience with weaving

• Attention to detail

• Problem-solving mindset

• Team player

• Stress-resistant

• Communicate in English, Dutch or French

• Willing to work 2 shifts

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

For our client located in Ostend, we are looking for a High Voltage Technician. This company specializes in large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

You job as a HIGH VOLTAGE ELECTRICIAN in OOSTENDE:

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.

For our client located in WESTENDE we are looking for a ROAD WORKER!

Our client is a well-known contractor who does assignments for the government and private sector.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and work outdoors? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE this is your job:

  • You are responsible for sewerage works;
  • You are responsible for placing embroidery;
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads and car parks;
  • Placing environmental pavements;
  • Placing roundabouts and refuges;
  • Placing vowels and paving stones;

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE you can find yourself in the following

  • You speak Englisch or Dutch
  • You are handy and like to work outside
  • No study requirements - motivation is what we need!

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;
  • You make sure that stability work is not overlooked;
  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:

  • A telehandler certificate is a plus!
  • You have extensive experience as a renovation worker;
  • You have a category B driving license and can easily commute to the company;
  • You speak Dutch or English

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

For a family-owned company located in Oudenburg, we are looking for a WORKSHOP CARPENTER.

Do you enjoy making and installing windows? We got you!

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in the Oudenburg region, your tasks will include:

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in Oudenburg, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • Physical work does not scare you!

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a Diagnostic Technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

For a customer in Peer we are looking for motivated employees in dayshift.

Do you have a good feeling for fashion? Are you available in dayshift? You are not allergic for dust? 

 

As sorting emplyee you have the following tasks:

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

For a well-known company with locations in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Chocolatier for the site in Bredene.

This is your job als CHOCOLATIER in BREDENE:

  • Tempering and preparing chocolate using production machines according to pre-defined recipes;
  • Checking taste, texture, and quality;
  • Hand-rolling chocolate;
  • Operating on arbagelines, oneshotline, and moulding lines;
  • Developing new chocolate combinations and recipes;
  • Cleaning machines and work areas according to instructions.
As a CHOCOLATIER 2 OR 3 SHIFTS in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have a good knowledge of chocolate and/or pastry;
  • You are motivated to work as a chocolatier in the food production environment;
  • You can work with machines (production);
  • You are willing to work in a 2 OR 3 shift system (you can choose one);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN.

This company is responsible for large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

A selection of your responsibilities as a CHARGING STATION ELECTRICIAN in the Veurne region:

  • Installation and commissioning of new charging stations;
  • Early detection of potential issues;
  • Checking the correct operation of installations;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving malfunctions;
  • Accurate and correct administrative processing of your interventions;
  • Carrying out inspections and resolving faults;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams to deliver customer-oriented and innovative solutions.

What our client in the Veurne region is looking for in a new colleague as a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN:

  • You have completed a training in electricity and/or have equivalent experience;
  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English (very well);
  • You have a technical background, as well as experience with charging stations, or a strong interest in this field;
  • You are motivated to become part of a growing company.

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Sewer installation works
  • Installing curbstones and edging
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
  • Laying environmental pavement solutions
  • Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
  • Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
  • Small to large-scale earthworks

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

  • You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
  • You have relevant experience in road construction;
  • You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
  • You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
  • You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.

For our client, we are looking for a FORMWORKER in the VEURNE region.

Our client is a supplier and manufacturing company of high-quality prefabricated concrete elements for architects.

As a FORMWORKER, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Installing formwork for concrete structures;
  • Assembling wooden or metal molds;
  • Pouring concrete and assisting with finishing work;
  • Reading plans and technical drawings;
  • Working with hand tools and machinery;
  • Checking that structures are level and correctly positioned;
  • Collaborating with crane operators and other workers.


If you start working as a FOMWORKER at our client in VEURNE, you should have the following skills:

  • You have experience as FORMWORKER OR CARPENTER;
  • You are able to read technical drawings;
  • You have a drivers licence;
  • A physical job and outside work is for you not an issue;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English.

Preventive Maintenance & Inspections: Perform maintenance work according to an established schedule. Following up on inspections, checklists and preparing work orders.

-External Parties: Receiving and supervising external suppliers and service providers, especially at times when your supervisor is absent.

-Lubrications: Taking care of the lubrication of technical installations, logging data and reporting to the person in charge.

-Electrical Inspections: Following up on electrical inspections, resolving any infringements and making as-built diagrams (initially with pen and then forwarding them digitally to our branch in West Flanders).

-Assistance in case of breakdowns: Assist in technical breakdowns together with the MCTec team to keep production processes optimal.

-Small Projects: Independently carry out small projects, such as rearranging changing rooms, moving ventilation or installing additional fire detectors, additional bath readers, ....

-Responsibility for Warehouse: passing on spare parts on time Breakdowns Warehouse (Ghent): Solving breakdowns in the automatic warehouse in Ghent.

-Have completed a technical education, preferably in an electromechanical field (min A2)

-Experience with maintenance and breakdowns in technical installations.

-You are practical and can work independently. -Eye for detail and work accurately. -Languages: Dutch & English

-Flexible and willing to work in both Zele and Ghent.

-Communicative skills and can work well with external parties and colleagues.

-Hands-on mentality and is proactive in solving problems.

jobs.occupation: Country Head of IT - Global Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a leading global industrial and manufacturing organization with operations across multiple continents and a strong presence in Thailand. The business operates in a highly technology-driven environment, with significant manufacturing operations and a broad international network.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the overall IT strategy and operations across Thailand.
• Act as the senior technology partner to country and business leadership.
• Ensure reliable, secure, and effective IT services across the organization.
• Oversee infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data, end-user services, and technology operations.
• Drive technology transformation and modernization initiatives aligned with business priorities.
• Establish strong IT governance, standards, policies, and risk management.
• Lead and develop the local IT organization and technology capabilities..
• Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers.
• Oversee IT budgets, investments, and resource planning.
• Work closely with regional and global technology teams on enterprise initiatives.
• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, efficiency, and scalability.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• 10+ years of experience in IT, with significant leadership responsibility
• Experience leading IT within a large, multinational organization
• Strong background across IT operations, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and technology transformation
• Experience managing teams, budgets, vendors, and complex technology environments
• Strong business partnering and stakeholder management capabilities
• Ability to operate effectively across both local and regional/global environments
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Preferred

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
• Previous country, regional, or enterprise IT leadership experience
• Experience leading technology transformation in a complex multinational organization
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity, governance, and IT risk
• Excellent English communication skills
